breakdown.description: The prompt treats the original x–y axes as principal directions even though a nonzero shear stress is present, so the principal stresses are not simply σ_x and 0.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly disregards the incorrect instruction to treat the original x-y axes as principal directions. It correctly instructs to use the standard plane stress transformation equations to compute the principal stresses σ_1 and σ_2, acknowledging that with a nonzero shear stress τ_xy present, the principal stresses cannot simply be σ_x and 0. This aligns with the ground truth prompt which omits the erroneous assumption entirely.
